newsitem.title: USA: Two CNA chiefs resign after women complain - Times.
newsitem.headline: Two CNA chiefs resign after women complain - Times.

text.p: The president and the chief administrative officer of CNA Financial Corp's life insurance unit have resigned following complaints by two women employees, the New York Times and Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.

An announcement from the company said CNA Life President Jack Kettler resigned for making "offensive comments," and that his deputy, Robert Teske, resigned after failing to act on the complaints, the papers reported.
Neither Kettler nor Teske were could be reached for comment, the newspapers said.
The report said the company did not specify the nature of the complaints, but the newspapers said some people familiar with the matter believed the women found the comments sexually offensive.
